questions.text: What execution does pause block? Code distinguishes scheduled, manual and existing Run attempts.
How does pause relate to enabled/disabled? Proposed separate persisted boolean, default false, idempotent preserving enabled.
How should pause appear on public surfaces? Proposed JSON field, POST responses, Paused dashboard column.
questions.note: Requested preferences beyond frozen product sheet; no extra product requirements supplied.

questions.text: Should resume catch up work missed while paused?

answer: Q1: scheduled start while paused skipped and not queued; manual Runs allowed; already progressing Run continues terminal with retries/alerts preserved. Q4: future schedule only, no catch-up. Q2/Q3: no additional product/interface preference; TASK.md/public interfaces/reversible engineering judgment.
